in_sanskrit.name: Kalayanth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Time
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kalayanth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kala’ meaning time and ‘Yanth’ meaning lord or ruler. This name signifies the ruler or god of time.

in_hindi.name: Kalayanth
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Time

in_tamil.name: Kalayanth
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God of Time
in_tamil.long_meaning: Kalayanth ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kala’ meaning time and ‘Yanth’ meaning lord or ruler. This name signifies the ruler or god of time.

in_telugu.name: Kalayanth
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God of Time
in_telugu.long_meaning: Kalayanth ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kala’ meaning time and ‘Yanth’ meaning lord or ruler. This name signifies the ruler or god of time.

in_marathi.name: Kalayanth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Time
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalayanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kala’ meaning time and ‘Yanth’ meaning lord or ruler. This name signifies the ruler or god of time.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Time
